civic_character.population: Hosts urban megacities where millions of species live together.
civic_character.infrastructure: Public infrastructure accommodates varied environmental needs — adjustable gravity, breathable-atmosphere zones, controlled temperature.
civic_character.context: Named among the core worlds alongside Vel-Surak (economic hub), Kaelor Prime (military command), GU-LOG-01 (industrial/fleet hub), ZY-TRADE-01 (Zyphari trade nexus), GU-FRONT-01 (frontier bastion) and VEL-BORDER-01 (Velar border world). The division is functional: capital, economy and military command sit on three different worlds.
